thread:
Ana Liu: Hey team — final assets for Capstone SI co-badged case study + AWS Marketplace listing are attached. Need marketing + legal + design sign‑off by EOD so we can publish Wed morning. Links: https://drive.redwood/capstone-case-study-v3.pdf and https://drive.redwood/aws-listing-draft.md. Main asks: 1) confirm logo usage + clearspace, 2) confirm customer quote is cleared, 3) shorten marketplace blurb to fit AWS 300-char lead. Attaching screenshots of listing.

Priya (Design): Looks good overall. Two visual notes: capstone logo needs 24px clearspace on all sides, and on dark backgrounds use white-reversed mark. I need SVGs for both partner and customer logos (not PNG). Also changing CTA colour to #0066FF — will push an updated PDF in 30m.

Jordan (Legal): Quick heads-up — we need a written approval from the customer for the exact quote text and permission to use their logo in a marketplace context. Do we have an email thread? If not, request now. Also flagging that the case study references a cost-savings number — please confirm the source or remove.

Mike R.: Re: AWS blurb — AWS enforces a shortDescription around 150-300 chars; here's a suggestion we can paste: "Redwood Inference + Capstone: Reduce per-token cost while maintaining latency SLOs. Turnkey deployment on dedicated GPU pools with enterprise-grade controls." I'll shorten if needed. For tags use: inference, llm, dedicated-gpu, enterprise.

Claire D.: Capstone's partner manager sent high-res logos earlier today (see Drive). They confirmed logo usage for case studies in the signed partner agreement — I attached the signed MSA excerpt. Clearspace per Priya's note is fine. On the customer quote: Capstone forwarded a redline from the customer, but not explicit sign-off. Jordan — can we accept an email thread that says "looks good" or do you need a signed PDF?

Jordan (Legal): Email thread is fine if the customer's PM explicitly says "approved for publication" and the quoted text is pasted in that email. If it's a redline, we need the final agreed version. Also confirm the cost-savings source in writing (internal calc or customer-provided).

Ana Liu: Uploaded revised assets: https://drive.redwood/capstone-case-study-final.pdf (v4) and https://drive.redwood/aws-listing-final.md (v2). Priya changed CTA colour and exported SVGs. Claire — can you ping Capstone PM for a quick approval statement? I'll also request the quote sign-off from the customer.

Mike R.: FYI — sample AWS listing JSON we plan to paste into the console (trim before paste):

```json
{
  "productName": "Redwood Inference — Capstone SI Solution",
  "shortDescription": "Turnkey LLM inference with predictable throughput and cost optimizations; co-developed with Capstone SI.",
  "longDescription": "Redwood Inference and Capstone deliver a dedicated GPU solution that reduces per-token cost via intelligent batching, KV caching, and quantization recommendations. Includes enterprise SLA and private deployment options.",
  "keywords": ["inference","llm","dedicated-gpu","enterprise","capstone"],
  "supportEmail": "partners@redwood.com"
}
```

Priya (Design): Updated PDF looks good — spacing fixed, SVGs validated. One tiny request: on page 2 move the quote block 8px down to align with the grid. I'll export final PNGs for the marketplace hero.

partners-bot: Publishing job scheduled: workspace=partnerships, job=capstone-publish, publish_time=1769072400 (Wed 09:00 PST). Use /partners cancel-capstone to abort.

Jordan (Legal): Confirmed — Claire shared an email where the customer PM wrote "approved for publication" (see Drive excerpt). Cost-savings number attributed to internal measurement logic dated 2026-02-28 — that's fine. Legal sign-off: cleared.

Priya (Design): final approve :thumbsup: exported hero PNGs attached.

Mike R.: LGTM. I'll do the AWS console upload tomorrow AM and add the tags. Ana — want me to handle the marketplace screenshots too?

Ana Liu: Yes please, Mike. Thanks everyone — tagging @here for visibility. Once AWS goes live I'll announce in marketing channel and coordinate the joint press note with Capstone.
